children: HC Wainwright & Co. reiterated their Buy rating on Eton Pharmaceuticals's stock with a price target of $70.00.
The price target implies an upside of 31.3% from the Oct 13 close of $53.33.
Key takeaways from the analyst note
Strong Pipeline of Rare Disease Products

: Eton Pharmaceuticals has a robust portfolio with eight commercial rare disease products and five additional late-stage development candidates, indicating a solid foundation for sustained revenue growth and the ability to address unmet patient needs.

: The recent acquisition of LIBERVANT, a buccal film for seizure clusters, positions Eton to tap into a substantial market exceeding $450 million annually, further enhancing their growth prospects and reinforcing confidence in their future revenue streams.
